Cancel a booking

Add cancel(bookingId, at) to the rental service. It releases the booked
period of the cancelled booking and returns { bookingId, refund }: the
full total when cancelled at least 24 hours before the start, else 0.
A booking can be cancelled only once; an unknown id or a malformed at is
refused without changing state. Covers AC29-AC35 of task-005.
